messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: If you have a planned surgery or dental procedure, your doctor may tell you to stop taking apixaban for a short time.
Doses are based on weight in children and teenagers. Your child's dose may change if the child gains or loses weight.
If your child vomits within 30 minutes after taking apixaban, take another dose. If the child vomits after more than 30 minutes of taking apixaban, do not take another dose and give the next dose as scheduled.
Do not change your dose or stop taking apixaban unless your doctor tells you to. If you stop taking apixaban for any reason, your doctor may prescribe another medicine to prevent blood clots. Keep all follow-up visits with your healthcare provider.
Store at room temperature away from moisture and heat.
Triplet: ["apixaban", "has alternative therapy if stopped", "medicine to prevent blood clots"]

The relation 'has alternative therapy if stopped' in the triplet is defined as 'If the subject drug is discontinued, the patient should be prescribed the therapy specified by the object entity to maintain treatment efficacy.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'has discontinuation rate': A specified percentage of patients discontinue use of the subject drug as indicated by the object entity.
C. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
D. 'has withdrawal symptom': When the subject drug is stopped abruptly, the patient may experience the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'has missed dose instruction': If a dose of the subject drug is missed the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
